items.lede: Apple's iPhone Duo has been officially on sale for two weeks, and the company said today that the App Store now has over 100,000 apps that are built for the foldable. items.title: The iPhone Duo has more than 100,000 optimized apps, Apple says

items.lede: There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple, and thousands more arrive daily.
